title: Oral History of Gary Davidian, part 2 of 2
summary: Part two of a Computer History Museum oral history with Gary Davidian, covering his work on the 68000 emulator for PowerPC at Apple, Power Computing, clean-room contracting and later performance optimization work. It is nearly three hours long.
why: Pointed to as a primary-source interview on Apple's architecture transitions, emulation and microcode work.

quote.text: There’s an interview with him in the Computer History Museum archive.
